items.title: Labymod compatibility with ModMenu, not showing on Title Screen
items.body: With the latest LabyClient update, the ModMenu no longer displays the mod menu on the title screen. It is only shown in the in-game pause menu. This is an issue as some mods require configuration prior to joining a server.

items.title: Backport Update Check to 1.17

labels.name: help wanted
labels.description: This could be resolved quicker with help

items.body:
Would it be possible to backport the mod update checking function to 1.17.1?

It's non-trivial to check via the Modrinth website. I can filter by game version and sort by date updated, but the sorting is NOT based on when mods were last updated for the selected game version(s), but rather on the last update for any game version. (I'll be asking for version-selection-aware sorting in Modrinth, too, but having checks in ModMenu too would give the full feature buildout.)

Thanks!

items.title: FILTER UPDATES
items.body:
Just a simple button to only display mods detected as having an update.

It's tiresome having to slowly scroll through the entire list for the 437th time, especially with a large modlist

items.title: [1.21.x] es_es.json is invalid JSON (missing comma), and V2-deprecated toast references undefined translation keys
items.body:
Two separate issues on the `1.21.9` branch (the line that `modmenu-16.0.1` for MC 1.21.10 is built from). Both are already resolved on `26.x`, so this is only about the 1.21.x maintenance line.

---

## 1. `es_es.json` is invalid JSON — the whole Spanish translation fails to load

`src/main/resources/assets/modmenu/lang/es_es.json` is missing a comma after line 172:

```json
   171:   "option.modmenu.button_update_badge.true": "SÍ",
   172:   "option.modmenu.button_update_badge.false": "NO"     <-- comma missing
   173:   "option.modmenu.quick_configure": "Configuración rápida",
   174:   "option.modmenu.quick_configure.true": "SÍ",
```

A parser stops at line 173 col 3 with `Expecting ',' delimiter`. Because a language file is one JSON object, a structural error like this doesn't degrade gracefully — the whole file fails, so Spanish users get English for all of Mod Menu rather than losing a single string.

Worth noting Gson's lenient mode doesn't rescue this. Leniency covers comments, single quotes and unquoted names, but a missing separator between object members still fails ("Unterminated object"), so this isn't one of the cases MC tolerates.

**Caveat on my end:** I verified the file is invalid JSON, but I play in English and haven't watched it fail in-game, so I haven't observed the user-facing symptom directly.

**Status across branches:**

| branch | `es_es.json` |
|---|---|
| `1.21.9` | **invalid** (line 173) |
| `26.1` | valid |
| `26.2` | valid |
| `26.4` (default) | valid |

So it looks like the fix landed on the 26.x line and wasn't backported.

Possibly adjacent to #355 ("Duplicate current spanish translation"), which is open — that one is about duplicated entries rather than a syntax error, so I filed separately, but if you're touching `es_es.json` anyway they may be worth doing together.

---

## 2. V2-deprecated toast shows raw translation keys

`UpdateCheckerUtil.triggerV2DeprecatedToast()` builds a `SystemToast` from two keys that don't exist in `en_us.json`:

```java
// src/main/java/com/terraformersmc/modmenu/util/UpdateCheckerUtil.java:160-165
public static void triggerV2DeprecatedToast() {
    if (modrinthApiV2Deprecated && ModMenuConfig.UPDATE_CHECKER.getValue()) {
        MinecraftClient.getInstance().getToastManager().add(new SystemToast(SystemToast.Type.PERIODIC_NOTIFICATION,
            Text.translatable("modmenu.modrinth.v2_deprecated.title"),
            Text.translatable("modmenu.modrinth.v2_deprecated.description")
        ));
    }
}
```

The only `modmenu.modrinth`-prefixed key in `en_us.json` on this branch is `modmenu.modrinth` itself (`"Modrinth"`). Neither `…v2_deprecated.title` nor `…v2_deprecated.description` is defined — I also checked `de_de` and the shipped `modmenu-16.0.1.jar`, same result.

So whenever Modrinth's v2 API is flagged deprecated and the update checker is on, the toast renders the literal strings `modmenu.modrinth.v2_deprecated.title` / `modmenu.modrinth.v2_deprecated.description` instead of readable text.

This is gone on `26.4` — `triggerV2DeprecatedToast` and the keys don't appear there at all, so the code was removed rather than the strings added. Either backporting that removal or adding the two keys would fix it.

---

### How these were found

Two static passes over my installed mods:

1. Extracted the `CONSTANT_Utf8` pool from every `.class` file, kept strings shaped like translation keys whose namespace matches one of the mod's own lang namespaces, and diffed against `en_us.json`. That surfaced issue 2. (It also flagged `sodium.codegen.dump` and `sodium.debug.shaders.dump` in Sodium, which are system property names rather than translation keys — false positives, not reported.)
2. Parsed all 154 of Mod Menu's language files; `es_es.json` was the only one that failed.
